newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RAINBOW CHICKEN SHARES GUTTED BY LOSSES.
newsitem.headline: RAINBOW CHICKEN SHARES GUTTED BY LOSSES.

text.p: Shares in Rainbow Chicken Ltd tumbled 10 percent on Wednesday, knocked by news late on Tuesday of further huge losses in the year to March.
The stock was the third biggest loser by percentage on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, falling 10 cents to 88 cents in a volume of 108,000 shares.
Rainbow announced a year attributable loss of 222.99 million rand, dragging its bottom line further into the red from its previous loss of 159.81 million rand.
The company also said it expected to report continued losses for the six months to September 1997.

"Those results were very poor and the share is going to take quite a bashing from that news. There's a chance some guys might try and snap up a bargain later but I think it's going to come off quite a bit before that happens," one dealer said.
Rainbow's share price has fallen 35 percent since touching a high of 136 cents on January 28. In August last year the share sank to 63 cents.
